subject.title: feat: add feed item watches and notification inbox

question: Should ClawHub accept a public, durable feed-watch and notification-inbox foundation now even though event production, inbox presentation, and the declared predecessor PR are not yet landed?
rationale: The code introduces durable private state and public API/schema surface, while the PR explicitly defers the only path that creates inbox events; deciding whether that intermediate contract is acceptable requires product and API-ownership intent.

options.title: Keep the stack draft until it is coherent
options.body: Require the predecessor, producer integration, and redacted real-runtime proof before reviewing this as a mergeable notification feature.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowly versioned foundation
options.body: Accept the watch/inbox storage contract now only with explicit API ownership, upgrade/retention proof, and documentation that the endpoints are intentionally inactive until the follow-up lands.

options.title: Split to a smaller prerequisite
options.body: Retain only the independently useful publisher-feed or follow-graph foundation and defer notification-inbox routes and schema until their producer is ready.

recommendation.title: Keep the stack draft until it is coherent
recommendation.body: Require the predecessor, producer integration, and redacted real-runtime proof before reviewing this as a mergeable notification feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The related review history connects this person to the adjacent hosted catalog-feed architecture that defines the closest existing contract boundary.
